subject: maths
question: Marked price of a TV is listed at Rs. 24,500. If it's selling price is Rs. 20,090, then what is the discount percentage?
solution:
Given:

M.P = 24500

S.P = 20090

Formula used:

S.P = M.P × {(100% - discount%)/100}

Discount = (M.P - S.P)/M.P × 100

Calculation:

Discount = (M.P - S.P)/M.P × 100

⇒ (24500 - 20090)/24500 × 100

⇒ 4410/245

⇒ 18 %

The discount percentage at which the watch is being sold is 18%.
